newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia to deport Filipino shipwreck survivors.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia to deport Filipino shipwreck survivors.

text.p: Malaysia said on Saturday it planned to deport 20 Filipino survivors from a boat that capsized off Sabah state last week, killing at least 16 passengers.
Anuar Bashah Sohore, police chief in the town of Sandakan, was quoted by the national Bernama news agency as saying that authorities had not yet set a date for the deportation.
The boat was trying to cross illegally into Sabah when it foundered in rough seas in the Sulu Sea off Sandakan, about 240 km (150 miles) from the Sabah capital of Kota Kinabalu.
Sixteen of its passengers drowned and one is still missing, police said.
A passing fishing boat rescued the 20 Filipinos, who are being housed at a transit detention camp in Sandakan.
Sabah, Malaysia's closest territory to the Philippines, has an army of illegal Filipino workers who have crossed into the state to fill an acute shortage of labour.
An estimated 500,000 foreign workers -- about half of them from the Philippines - - work in timber and oil-rich Sabah on Borneo island.
